facts.text: Fairmont Mayakoba was the first resort built in the Mayakoba community, where construction began in 2003.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Mayakoba was the first resort to be built in the Mayakoba community, which began construction in 2003.

facts.text: The property is designed around a network of waterways.
facts.excerpt: Designed around a network of crystal clear waterways, the property is situated deep within 240 acres of dense tropical forest.

facts.text: Accommodations are split between rooms, casitas and suites, with views of the mangroves, the canal or the Caribbean Sea depending on category.
facts.excerpt: The 401 contemporary accommodations are split between three categories: rooms, casitas, and suites. Depending on the room category, the views will be of the mangroves, the canal, or the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Rooms reflect modern Mexican design and have deep marble soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Rooms are bright and airy to reflect modern Mexican design and have deep marble soaking tubs.

facts.text: Certain bookings include access to a Balam, a special assistant similar to a butler, and a select itinerary of exclusive activities.
facts.excerpt: Certain bookings also include access to a Balam (a special assistant, similar to a butler) and a select itinerary of exclusive activities.

facts.text: The Beach Front Suite has a private terrace with an infinity pool and ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Experience stunning ocean views from your private terrace with an infinity pool.

facts.text: Fairmont rooms include access to the Bamboo Tower's dedicated pool.
facts.excerpt: Tranquillity, spaciousness, thoughtful amenities, and access to the Bamboo Tower's dedicated pool are just the beginning.

facts.text: The resort has five swimming pools, three of them along the oceanfront.
facts.excerpt: Families will love spending time outdoors at one of Fairmont Mayakoba’s five swimming pools, including the three along the oceanfront with alluring views of the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: Children eat free when choosing from the children's menu and have free programming at the Balam and Coatí Kids Clubs.
facts.excerpt: they eat free when selecting a meal from the children’s menu and have access to free programming at the Balam and Coatí Kids Clubs

facts.text: Dining includes the Greek restaurant Gaia and Ki, a beach bar and Korean grill.
facts.excerpt: including the Greek restaurant Gaia, and Ki, a beach bar and Korean grill

facts.text: Cielo Rooftop Bar is a lounge-style, adults-only bar with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: the lounge-style, adults-only Cielo Rooftop Bar with ocean views

facts.text: The spa garden has a grounding path lined with Melipona beehives, a cold plunge pool and a temazcal sweat lodge.
facts.excerpt: In the garden, guests will find a grounding path lined with Melipona beehives, a cold plunge pool, and a temazcal sweat lodge.

facts.text: Most spa treatments draw inspiration from Mayan cosmology and are based on the lunar calendar.
facts.excerpt: Most treatments draw inspiration from Mayan cosmology and are based on the lunar calendar.

facts.text: El Camaleón is a Greg Norman-designed 18-hole championship golf course.
facts.excerpt: El Camaleón at Fairmont Mayakoba is a Greg Norman-designed, 18-hole championship course

facts.text: Guests can snorkel the Mesoamerican Reef from a catamaran and take part in a coral restoration activity.
facts.excerpt: Board a catamaran and prepare for a breathtaking adventure on the Mesoamerican Reef

facts.text: The Dive & Water Sports Center offers scuba diving, jet ski rentals and private yacht charters.
facts.excerpt: guests also have access to the Dive & Water Sports Center, offering a wide range of water activities, including scuba diving, jet ski rentals, and private yacht charters

facts.text: Culinary workshops range from authentic Mexican recipes to mixology lessons.
facts.excerpt: From authentic Mexican recipes to mixology lessons, from classes to demonstrations, our culinary workshops invite you to savor the delight of discovery.

facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly.
facts.excerpt: The Fairmont Mayakoba offers concierge services and is also pet-friendly.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed in the pool or beach areas.
facts.excerpt: pets are not permitted in the pool or beach areas

facts.text: A daily housekeeping fee of $25 USD applies for pets.
facts.excerpt: A daily housekeeping fee of $25 USD applies.

facts.text: Valet parking is included in all stays (one car per room) and the resort has no self-park lots.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is included in all Fairmont Mayakoba stays (one car per room). The resort does not have self-park parking lots.

facts.text: Cancun International Airport is about 30 miles (48 kilometers) from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Cancun International Airport (CUN) is located approximately 30 miles (48 kilometers) from Fairmont Mayakoba.

facts.text: The all-inclusive package does not include El Pueblito or the El Camaleón Golf Course.
facts.excerpt: El Pueblito and El Camaleón Golf Course are not included.

facts.text: Bottles of wine and liquor are not included in the all-inclusive package.
facts.excerpt: Any bottle of wine or liquor in our restaurants, bars, or minibar service is not included and will incur an additional charge.
